items.summary: Enhance the 'NFS MODS HUB' text in the navigation bar (`frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx`) with a neon glow effect using CSS text-shadow with the neon accent color (#C8FF00). Ensure the Barlow Condensed bold typeface is applied. Optionally add a subtle pulsing or static glow animation to make the branding visually striking.

Apply neon glow styling to other key accent elements across the site (e.g., the 'Upload Mod' button, active nav links, download buttons, category badges, and card hover borders) using CSS box-shadow or text-shadow with the neon accent color (#C8FF00). Define reusable Tailwind utility classes or CSS custom properties for neon glow effects in `frontend/src/index.css` or `frontend/tailwind.config.js` so the effect is applied consistently.
